rules.cutoff: Estimated competitive cutoff for a typical General-category Engineer Male profile only when an official competitive cutoff is not published.
rules.other_metrics: No estimation. Fee, placement average, placement median, intake, exam, programme and ranking/location must come from the college profile or an official source.
rules.intake_definition: Approved PG intake for 2-year programmes reported in NIRF 2025; it may include more than one 2-year management programme at an institute.
rules.placement_definition: Average and median CTC/salary from the stated placement cycle; do not mix highest-package figures into the comparison outcome.
